scenario_name: Guest references a bad past experience
expected_behavior: Takes the complaint seriously without being defensive. Apologizes specifically for the wait time. Offers a concrete alternative for this visit and suggests mentioning the issue to the Momentum Desk for follow-up. Turns the complaint into a chance to demonstrate that things are different now
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest references a negative experience, the agent acknowledges it specifically, investigates without being defensive, and reframes the next visit as a fresh start. Does not minimize the complaint or rush past it.

turns.user_message: Last time I was here the service at the steakhouse was awful. Took forever to get seated
turns.agent_response:
I completely understand how frustrating that is. Waiting forever to get seated really takes the excitement out of a nice meal, and I want to make sure your experience is seamless this time around. 

If you are still craving an exceptional steak, Michael Jordan's Steak House in Casino of the Sky is fantastic. They serve incredible USDA Prime steaks alongside a great wine list, and I can connect you with our host team to lock in a firm reservation so you can walk right to your table when they open at 5:00 PM. If you would rather skip the formal dining room entirely today, Lantern Bar & Grill is open right now and serves a great steak in a much more casual, walk-in friendly setting. 

After you eat, the Wolf Den has free live music right in the Casino of the Earth to help turn the evening around and keep things fun. Are you leaning toward giving a fine dining experience another try, or would you prefer keeping it relaxed tonight?
